svg.text: Idle sawmill: the plank saw (row 2) by level: 1, 25 and 50
the log lies still and is whole below the blade; each pass cuts the top plank off (it lifts a little, then it is gone), 1st, 2nd and 3rd; the last cut leaves the 3rd and 4th plank
the first pass cuts two planks at once (the top one and the one under it), the second pass has one cut left, so one blade works and the other waits in its post
all three cuts at once: the log is whole only below the lowest blade, three planks lift off above the blades and the fourth stays; shown going out and coming back
